Thanks for flagging — I pulled the SAML trace for the failed attempt (matched to the timestamp Diego requested) and see the issue. The SAML assertion coming from the invite flow is sending org alias "ellison" but our Ariba tenant expects "ellison-supply" in the tenant claim. Ariba treats that claim as the canonical tenant identifier, so the mismatch is rejected during assertion validation.

What I did:
1) Confirmed the assertion payload in our logs (we can share redacted trace if helpful).
2) Reset the invite token and updated the invite metadata to include tenant=ellison-supply. I created a new invite from the Admin Console: 
   https://app.redwood.com/admin/invites?tenant=ellison-supply
3) Requested Marissa to resend the invite to the same onboarding address.

If you prefer to avoid email invite flow, you can accept via a one-time redirect URL I can generate (valid for 24h). Evan — let us know if you'd like that instead.

Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
